notes: The form only asks what the ticked services need. Photography, drone, bonded internet, vision mixing and IMAG direction now get a crew call, a wrap and an overtime rate, which they never had; and the load-in, camera positions and card planning only appear when there are cameras of yours to rig – so a photography-only or editing-only job stops being asked about any of it, and its kit-plan step no longer waits for positions that were never coming.
